assessed_concepts: Original source task: Describe the role of a firewall.
Describe how a firewall applies a rule that blocks unsolicited incoming connections to a research computer

markscheme.marking_summary: It inspects incoming traffic against configured rules. Traffic matching the blocked connection rule is rejected; traffic permitted by other rules may pass. This reduces unauthorized network access but does not remove all malicious content in allowed traffic.
source_issues: Source MS suggests a firewall detects/prevents viruses generically; rewritten criteria avoid claiming all firewalls provide antivirus inspection.

mappings.scope_evidence:
• The function of firewalls in inspecting and filtering incoming and outgoing traffic based on whitelists, blacklists and rules
• The strengths and limitations of firewalls
• The role of NAT to enhance network security
mappings.rationale: Describe how a firewall applies a rule that blocks unsolicited incoming connections to a research computer assesses Discuss the effectiveness of firewalls at protecting a network.
